blocks.text: [Updated Oct. 8, 2026, 7:06 p.m.] MANILA, Philippines — Records from the Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR) revealed Vice President Sara Duterte’s cash on hand and in banks – money which she did not declare in her statements of assets, liabilities and net worth (Saln) since she assumed her post. Citing the Audited Financial Statements (AFS) of Duterte and her husband, Manases Carpio, BIR Chief of Staff Anne Loraine Garcia-Marquez said the couple made the following cash declarations from 2022 to 2025: As of December 31, 2022: P21,234,980 As of December 31, 2023: P28,971,725 As of December 31, 2024: P15,525,209 As of […]...
